title: pvLine
body:
## pvLine

Creates a straight line from Point1 to Point2 as a polyline with intermediate points: either Resolution equal segments (UseRegularRefinement true, the default) or points at the fractions listed in RefinementRatios. Use it as a probe or seed line, a ruler-like annotation or a reference edge; to sample data along a line use probeLine.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The output has only geometry (and texture coordinates); it samples nothing until used by a probe or resample operation.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Line`. Identity: `sources/LineSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Point1` | This property controls the coordinates of the first endpoint of the line. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Point2` | This property controls the coordinates of the second endpoint of the line. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `RefinementRatios` | Specify refinements ration in the range [0.0, 1.0] where to add points along the line segment. 0.0 and 1.0 must be added to add the start and end points, if needed. | `{"items":{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[0.0]` |
| `Resolution` | This property specifies the number of pieces into which to divide the line. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `UseRegularRefinement` | If set, the line segment will be generated with regular subdivisions (specified by **Resolution**), else the subdivisions must be explicitly specified. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvLine"
}
```
